name: ThemePicker
label: Theme picker
description: A circular trigger wearing the active theme's swatch, opening a menu of every theme on offer with its colour, corner and faces.

props.name: themes
props.description: The themes on offer, in the order the menu lists them.

props.name: value
props.description: The active theme, controlled. Leave undefined to let the picker keep its own, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The active theme on first render when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first theme.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the chosen theme's value. The host applies it (a `data-brand` attribute on `<html>`, for the shipped presets).

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is open, controlled. Leave undefined to let the picker open and close itself.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the menu starts open when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the picker is disabled: the trigger takes no press and the menu cannot open.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger size, on the row-control scale: `default` is 40px, `compact` 32px.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the trigger the menu prefers; it flips when that side has no room.

props.name: align
props.description: Which trigger edge the menu lines up with.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content after the themes, below a divider: a link to make a theme of your own, say. Give each control in it `role="menuitem"`, since a menu holds only menu items; the arrow keys reach it.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the trigger, given the active theme's name. Defaults to "Theme: " followed by it.
